newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks weaken slightly after U.S. trade dat.
newsitem.headline: French stocks weaken slightly after U.S. trade dat.

text.p: French shares weakened very slightly after the release of U.S. international trade figures showed the gap widened by 17 percent. The U.S. Japan gap narrowed 25 percent.
The dollar was only slightly moved by the data. It was trading at 6.0760 francs and 1.7988 marks after the figures' release.
* CAC-40 index down 60.85, or 2.06 percent, at 2,897.74 at 1238 GMT, compared to down 2.03 percent at 2,898.58 just before the release.
* CAC-40 July futures 2,904 vs 2,966 at Thursdays close.
